card.name: Dose units right after a number
card.fires_on: Unit words such as mg, mcg (the g) and milligrams right after a dose or concentration number in dosing text. Also fires on the day in mg/m2/day.

modes.label: Units after a number
modes.description: mg, mcg or milligrams directly after a dose or concentration figure.
modes.example: the recommended dosage of arsenic trioxide injection is 0.15<< mg>>/kg/day intravenously daily in combination

modes.label: Split unit word
modes.description: The final piece of a unit split into parts, such as the g in mcg.
modes.example: Initiate treatment in adults with 50 mc<<g>> to 100 mcg.

modes.label: Rate wording
modes.description: The day in a per-day dose rate.
modes.example: The recommended starting replacement dosage is 8 to 10 mg/m 2 /<<day>> daily.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese and code words.
card.plain: It lights up on the unit, like mg or mcg, that comes right after a dose number.
